policy.text:
review and implementing entries recognized as reports or sayings in the main
numbered collections, while excluding side notes and explanations and obtaining
their correct collection references. This broadens the preceding Prophetic-only
reader selection: source-bound Companion and Successor reports, attributed
sayings, historical reports and explicitly abbreviated transmissions may enter
the reader under their actual report type and speaker. A Companion's words
must never be relabelled as the Prophet's words. Source criticism remains
visible alongside the version it discusses.

The presence of a provider number alone does not turn compiler explanation,
legal commentary, a heading or an empty placeholder into a narration. Preserve
those spans as source context. Review each admitted language's boundaries and
attribution independently; unreviewed sibling-language text remains complete
source context. Keep disjoint passages and distinct report components separate.

complete_original_readings.text: अब्दुल्लाह बिन शाक़िक़ अल-आकिलि कहते हैं के साहबा करम (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हुम) नमाज़ के सिवा किसी अमल के छोड़ देने को कुफ्र नहीं समझते थे. इमाम तिरमिधि कहते हैं: मैंने अबू मुस'अब मदनी को कहते हुए सुना के जो यह कहे के इमां सिर्फ क़ौल (यानि ज़बान से इक़रार करने) का नाम है उस से तौबा करायी जायेगी गर्दन मार दी जाएगी.

عبداللہ بن شقیق عقیلی کہتے ہیں کہ صحابہ کرام ( رضی الله عنہم ) نماز کے سوا کسی عمل کے چھوڑ دینے کو کفر نہیں سمجھتے تھے۔ امام ترمذی کہتے ہیں: میں نے ابومصعب مدنی کو کہتے ہوئے سنا کہ جو یہ کہے کہ ایمان صرف قول ( یعنی زبان سے اقرار کرنے ) کا نام ہے اس سے توبہ کرائی جائے گی، اگر اس نے توبہ کر لی تو ٹھیک، ورنہ اس کی گردن مار دی جائے گی۔

decision.main_numbered_report: Eligible source-bound report by Abdullah ibn Shaqiq about the Companions’ view; no Prophetic speech attribution is supplied.
decision.appended_abu_musab_saying: Preserve in attributed compiler legal/doctrinal context; do not promote it into narration/search as an independently numbered report.

reasoning: The appendix is a real finite statement with an explicit local hearing claim and a named speaker. The decision does not deny those source facts, depend on its severity, or require Prophetic attribution for eligibility.

The field explicitly transitions to Imam Tirmidhi’s own comment, which reports Abu Musab’s general doctrinal/legal rule about a definition of faith, repentance, and punishment. It is not a continuation of Abdullah ibn Shaqiq’s report about the Companions’ treatment of abandoned prayer.

The current owner scope admits actual numbered reports and sayings while expressly retaining compiler explanation and legal commentary as context. A named source for a compiler’s appended ruling establishes provenance but does not, by itself, change the appendix’s role into the main numbered report.

This decision is role-based, not a universal rejection of doctrinal content, legal judgments, named later speakers, or reported sayings. An actual separately presented numbered saying or finite reported encounter requires its own source-bound assessment.
The complete appendix and its explicit attribution should remain visible in each language’s context. No source words, identity, numbering, reference, or grade are to be changed.
own_field_difference: Urdu expressly supplies the repentance/otherwise conditional before the death clause. Hindi does not supply those connecting conditions; its printed sequence must remain as-is, without filling it from Urdu.
external_claims: None. No outside biography, authenticity, doctrine, law, or canonical identification was used.
